Physical disk free space was approximately 95 GiB; this was machine-wide reservation admission. The live executor remains healthy and was not stopped to bypass this refusal. This additional acceptance remains pending. The false machine-wide disk refusal is fixed locally by World source a89344ac (https://github.com/volter-ai/twin/pull/335): memory remains machine-wide, while disk claims count only against their verified root filesystem; unknown locations remain conservatively charged. Installed runtime and operator CLI resource modules match that source, with backups retained outside the repository. The original admission counted internal-disk claims against the external SSD. After correcting it, a smaller real shortage remained: about 2 GiB of this setup’s disposable compiler output was reclaimed, and the old blender-codeonly-review World, containing no services or tracked foreground workload, was stopped through World without purging its files. This restored the original 16 GiB runtime reservation. Temporary acceptance/build/test Worlds were stopped. Focused 17 lifecycle/resource tests, typecheck and seven construction tests passed; the new regression failed with the old accounting and passed with the fix. The broader runtime suite had 375 passes and four failures (TLS timeouts, remote certificate verification and an 8 GiB fixture admission); it is not claimed clean.
